description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the distribution of complexity instances within a benchmark, categorized into four types. The chart consists of four slices: “Uncrushable”, colored light orange, representing approximately 64.6% of the instances; “Scalable Oversight”, colored light blue, representing approximately 16.5%; “AuRe-verifiable”, colored light green, representing approximately 10.9%; and “General”, colored light gray, representing approximately 8.0%. The chart includes a legend labeling each color with its corresponding complexity instance type, and percentage labels are displayed within each slice. The slices are visually ordered from largest to smallest, proceeding clockwise from “Uncrushable” to “General”.
